description: SDPA forward over the region HIP_FLASH2_ENGINE claims (gfx942 only; HipFlash2FwdPlanBuilder.cpp isApplicable, HipFlash2FwdPlanBuilder.hpp useFlash2ForShape): half only, head size 64 or 128 with V and O at the same width, no mask or top-left causal (right_bound 0), BSHD or BHSD (the builder asks only for a head-dim stride of 1, which both layouts have), grouped-query heads with Hq a multiple of Hkv, seqlen_q a multiple of 64 (the K3 gate, which holds for causal and non-causal samples alike) and above the shape crossover, seqlen_q * seqlen_kv > ceil(seqlen_q / 64) * 6000, which for a multiple of 64 is seqlen_kv >= 94 whatever seqlen_q is; seqlen_kv has no gate of its own below INT32_MAX - 64 and is drawn from 1 to 2048 with the sizes around 64 and the crossover as boundaries, and a causal sample with seqlen_kv below seqlen_q is drawn too (top-left causal: row i sees keys 0..i, and every row sees key 0). No stats, attn_mask, scale tensor, sliding window, bottom-right causal or other feature is drawn: the builder declines stats and the attn_mask tensor outright and the other masks by the NO_MASK/TOP_LEFT_CAUSAL gate; SdpaFwd/Default holds the feature axes. The slice axis keeps two decline probes just outside the region, about a quarter of the samples after the constraints reject the draws that land on the wrong side: below_crossover (seqlen_q a multiple of 64 and seqlen_q * seqlen_kv at or under ceil(seqlen_q / 64) * 6000, so only the crossover gate can decline) and partial_q (seqlen_q not a multiple of 64 but above the crossover, so only K3 can decline). The alignment axis declares one alignment on Q, K, V and O (tensor_patches on uids 1, 0, 3, 2) and the engine needs 8 bytes from Q and O and 2 from K and V (K_Q_ALIGNMENT_BYTES, K_KV_ALIGNMENT_BYTES, K_O_ALIGNMENT_BYTES), so alignments 1, 2 and 4 decline whatever the shape; the probe-only SdpaFwd/Flash2 space isolates that. The placement axis puts the device pointers at exactly that alignment (exact) or misaligns Q (placement_uid 1) below it, a case that passes only if the backend rejects it (under, drawn as exact at alignment 1). The domain axis fills Q, K and V as in SdpaFwd/Default: large uses scale 8, V keeps free(-2,2) under wide and scale 2 under large, the nan and inf domains put the special fill on V alone (2^-12 of its elements) and only where no mask applies, and an infinity is never drawn for half (it falls back to the default fill, as SdpaFwd/Default does for a half sample). Those domain choices are inherited from the gfx950 probes of the bfloat16 SdpaFwd spaces and have not been measured on FLASH2 or on fp16: a WRONG there is a lead for a tolerance or a kernel question, not yet evidence of a defect. The cost ceiling b*hq*sq*skv*d <= 2**31 is the one of SdpaFwd/Default and SdpaFwd/Gfx950Dense (GPU reference cost ceiling, RFC 0023 section 14). Run it with --test-engine HIP_FLASH2_ENGINE, --test-config hip_flash2_engine/config/HIP_FLASH2_ENGINE.toml and HIP_FLASH2_KERNEL_DIR set (docs/running-tests.md).

derive.stride_q: [sq*hq*d, d, hq*d, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*d, sq*d, d, 1]
derive.stride_k: [skv*hkv*d, d, hkv*d, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv*d, skv*d, d, 1]
derive.stride_v: [skv*hkv*dv, dv, hkv*dv, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv*dv, skv*dv, dv, 1]
derive.stride_o: [sq*hq*dv, dv, hq*dv, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*dv, sq*dv, dv, 1]
derive.nf_ok: not causal and not (domain == 'inf' and (dtype == 'half' or scale > 1))
derive.dom_kind: 'fixed' if domain == 'constant' else ('special' if dom_poison else ('free' if domain in ['default', 'narrow', 'wide', 'positive', 'nan', 'inf'] else domain))
derive.dom_lo: -0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (-8 if domain == 'wide' else (0.25 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else -1)))
derive.dom_hi: 0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (8 if domain == 'wide' else (4 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else 1)))
derive.eff_placement: 'exact' if placement == 'under' and alignment < 2 else placement

constraints.reason: useFlash2ForShape (HipFlash2FwdPlanBuilder.hpp) takes a shape only above seqlen_q * seqlen_kv > ceil(seqlen_q / 64) * 6000; only the below_crossover probe slice is drawn under it
the below_crossover slice must be under the crossover, or it is an ordinary region sample whose axis label would be wrong
GPU reference cost ceiling (RFC 0023 section 14), as SdpaFwd/Default
